---
title: smalldocs 0.5.4
subtitle: Divs read as Pandoc reads them
date: 2026-10-22
author: Rahul Dave
categories: [release]
image: ../images/mark.svg
---

This release changes how smalldocs finds the end of a div. It now reads a div's lines as it reads the
rest of the page. A `:::` ends only a div in its own list item or quote. So these now work, as in Pandoc:

- A div on a list item's first line, as in `- ::: {.callout-note}` or `10. ::: {.callout-note}`.
- A div in a nested list, with four or more spaces before its `:::`.
- A `:::` in a list inside a div. Before, it could end the outer div early and leave a stray `:::`.
- A line with no indent right after a div's text, in a list or a quote. It now joins the text, as in Pandoc.
- A raw HTML line right before a div's `:::`.

The Markdown copies for agents follow the page in each of these cases.

A new test reads 135 cases of divs with Pandoc and with smalldocs, and checks that they agree. In 35 of
them they do not agree on purpose, and each of these cases says why.
